title: Checkout service
diagnosis: Cart abandonment spikes at peak because checkout p99 latency degrades under load and a single failure takes the whole flow down.

characteristics.name: scalability
characteristics.outcome: checkout stays responsive under peak traffic

characteristics.name: resilience
characteristics.outcome: a downstream failure degrades, not collapses
characteristics.metric: successful-checkout rate during a payment-provider outage
characteristics.rationale: single failure took the flow down

characteristics.name: evolvability
characteristics.outcome: a pricing change ships without touching checkout
characteristics.metric: modules touched by a pricing-rule change
characteristics.rationale: pricing churn must not destabilize the hot path

principles: fail open to a queue, never to an error
no synchronous calls on the hot path
non_goals: not a rewrite of the catalog service

acceptance.criterion: p99 checkout latency stays under 300ms at 10x load
checkout succeeds for >95% of carts during a simulated provider outage
